item.title: ISPs more likely to throttle netizens who connect through CG-NAT: Cloudflare
item.description:
📝 That effort found indicators of bias, because non-CGNAT IPs are more likely to be bots than CGNAT IPs, but ISPs are more likely to throttle traffic from the latter. “Despite bot scores that indicate traffic is more likely to be from human users, CGNAT IPs are subject to rate limiting three times more often than non-CGNAT IPs,” the pair wrote. The authors also acknowledge that all these problems would go away if the world just moved to IPv6, and that CGNAT was supposed to tide network operators over until that happened.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theregister.com/2025/11/03/cloudflare_cgnat_bias_research/
